svg.title: Glossy flame game badge, animated
svg.desc: Original glossy flame artwork with closely traced, clean-cut edges. The frame grows first, then the flame ignites and gently flickers. The small side flame and upper gold accents move independently; the two touching lower accents remain with the main flame to avoid cut seams. Big soft rotating celebration rays, source confetti and twinkles continue behind the badge. Embedded original PNG artwork and transparent exterior.
